name: Unemployment
overview: Scripture addresses the reality of unemployment with both compassion and assurance. Believers are called to show kindness and open hands to those in need, reflecting God's heart toward the poor (Deuteronomy 15:7). The Lord promises His peace and rest to those who labor and are burdened, reminding us not to be anxious about our provision but to trust in His sovereign care (Matthew 6:28; Matthew 11:28; John 14:27). God's plans for His people are always for good, offering hope and an expected future even in times of uncertainty (Jeremiah 29:11), and the righteous are assured that they will not be forsaken or left begging (Psalms 37:25).
